title: Aviation mechanic eligibility, ratings, knowledge, experience and skill practice questions
description: Practice questions on FAA mechanic eligibility, ratings, and the written, experience, oral and practical test rules (14 CFR 65.71-65.80).

questions.question: Lee will apply for a mechanic certificate and will work at a repair shop in the United States, so the outside-the-United-States endorsement does not apply. Which English language abilities does 65.71(a)(2) require Lee to have?

options.A: Speak and understand English; reading and writing are not required
options.B: Read and write English; speaking is not required
options.C: Read English well enough to follow maintenance manuals, in any language the Administrator accepts
options.D: Read, write, speak, and understand the English language

questions.explanation: To be eligible, a person must "Be able to read, write, speak, and understand the English language"; the endorsement "Valid only outside the United States" applies only to an applicant "employed outside of the United States by a U.S. air carrier".

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.71, Eligibility requirements: General (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: An applicant who cannot meet the English language requirement is employed outside of the United States by a U.S. air carrier. What does 65.71(a)(2) provide for this applicant?

options.A: The applicant may hold a certificate only while that air carrier employs the applicant
options.B: The applicant's certificate is endorsed "Valid only outside the United States"
options.C: The applicant may take the tests in a language chosen by the Administrator
options.D: The applicant must first complete 30 months of practical experience

questions.explanation: For "an applicant who does not meet this requirement and who is employed outside of the United States by a U.S. air carrier," the rule says to "have his certificate endorsed “Valid only outside the United States”".

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.71, Eligibility requirements: General (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 65.71(a)(3), what must an applicant for a mechanic certificate have done within a period of 24 months?

options.A: Passed all of the prescribed tests
options.B: Completed all of the practical experience required by 65.77
options.C: Received an authenticated document from a certificated aviation maintenance technician school
options.D: Received the report of the written test

questions.explanation: The applicant must "Have passed all of the prescribed tests within a period of 24 months".

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.71, Eligibility requirements: General (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Besides age, language and the tests, what else does 65.71(a) require of an applicant for a mechanic certificate and associated ratings?

options.A: Employment by a certificated repair station
options.B: Compliance with every section of Subpart D for both ratings, whichever rating is sought
options.C: Compliance with the sections of Subpart D that apply to the rating the applicant seeks
options.D: A repairman certificate held for at least 24 months

questions.explanation: 65.71(a)(4) requires the person to "Comply with the sections of this subpart that apply to the rating the applicant seeks."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.71, Eligibility requirements: General (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Which ratings does 65.73(a) say are issued under Subpart D?

options.A: Airframe and powerplant
options.B: Airframe, powerplant and propeller
options.C: Aircraft and aircraft engine
options.D: General, airframe and powerplant

questions.explanation: "The following ratings are issued under this subpart: (1) Airframe. (2) Powerplant."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.73, Ratings (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A mechanic holds a certificate with an aircraft engine rating that was issued before, and was valid on, June 15, 1952. What does 65.73(b) say about it?

options.A: It expired on June 15, 1952
options.B: It may be exchanged only after the holder passes new oral and practical tests
options.C: It is equal to a mechanic certificate with the corresponding airframe or powerplant rating and may be exchanged for that certificate and rating
options.D: It is valid only outside the United States

questions.explanation: Such a certificate "is equal to a mechanic certificate with an airframe or powerplant rating, or both, as the case may be, and may be exchanged for such a corresponding certificate and rating or ratings."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.73, Ratings (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A certificated mechanic with an airframe rating applies for the powerplant rating. What does 65.71(b) require, apart from the exception in 65.75(d)?

options.A: Passing only the oral test for the powerplant rating
options.B: Retaking the tests for the airframe rating already held
options.C: Meeting the requirements of 65.77 only, with no further tests
options.D: Meeting the requirements of 65.77 and, within a period of 24 calendar months, passing the 65.75 and 65.79 tests for the powerplant rating

questions.explanation: The mechanic "must meet the requirements of § 65.77 and, within a period of 24 calendar months, pass the tests prescribed by §§ 65.75 and 65.79 for the additional rating sought, except as provided in § 65.75(d)."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.71, Eligibility requirements: General (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Except as specified in 65.75(c), when does 65.75(a) say an applicant for a mechanic certificate or rating must pass the written test?

options.A: Before beginning any practical experience
options.B: After meeting the applicable experience requirements of 65.77
options.C: After passing the oral and practical tests
options.D: During the first month of any aviation maintenance technician school course

questions.explanation: Each applicant "must, after meeting the applicable experience requirements of § 65.77, pass a written test".

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.75, Knowledge requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: What does 65.75(a) say the written test includes?

options.A: Only the airframe subject areas, whichever rating is sought
options.B: Subject areas chosen by the applicant's employer
options.C: Questions drawn from the applicant's own maintenance records
options.D: The aeronautical knowledge subject areas contained in the Aviation Mechanic General, Airframe, and Powerplant Airman Certification Standards, as appropriate to the rating sought

questions.explanation: The written test "includes the aeronautical knowledge subject areas contained in the Aviation Mechanic General, Airframe, and Powerplant Airman Certification Standards (incorporated by reference, see § 65.23), as appropriate to the rating sought."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.75, Knowledge requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: According to 65.75(b), what is sent to the applicant after the written test?

options.A: A report of the written test
options.B: A temporary mechanic certificate
options.C: The graded test booklet
options.D: An inspection authorization

questions.explanation: 65.75(b) states: "A report of the written test is sent to the applicant."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.75, Knowledge requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: What does 65.77 require each applicant for a mechanic certificate or rating to present?

options.A: Both a school document and documentary evidence of practical experience
options.B: A letter of recommendation from any certificated mechanic
options.C: Either an authenticated document from a certificated aviation maintenance technician school in accordance with 147.21, or documentary evidence, satisfactory to the Administrator, of the required practical experience
options.D: A logbook endorsed by the holder of an inspection authorization

questions.explanation: Each applicant "must present either—" "An authenticated document from a certificated aviation maintenance technician school in accordance with § 147.21 of this chapter; or" "Documentary evidence, satisfactory to the Administrator, of—" the listed experience.

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.77, Experience requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: An applicant without a school document relies on 65.77(b)(2) for experience. What must that practical experience have involved?

options.A: Performing the duties of an inspection authorization holder
options.B: Concurrently performing the duties appropriate to both the airframe and powerplant ratings
options.C: Teaching the general portion of a part 147 school curriculum
options.D: Performing only the duties appropriate to the airframe rating

questions.explanation: 65.77(b)(2) calls for "practical experience concurrently performing the duties appropriate to both the airframe and powerplant ratings."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.77, Experience requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Which describes the practical experience in 65.77(b)(1)?

options.A: At least 18 months of practical experience with the procedures, practices, materials, tools, machine tools, and equipment generally used in constructing, maintaining, or altering airframes or powerplants, appropriate to the rating sought
options.B: At least 18 months of practical experience concurrently performing the duties appropriate to both the airframe and powerplant ratings
options.C: At least 18 months of classroom instruction in any subject related to aviation
options.D: At least 18 months of experience operating aircraft as a pilot

questions.explanation: 65.77(b)(1) reads "At least 18 months of practical experience with the procedures, practices, materials, tools, machine tools, and equipment generally used in constructing, maintaining, or altering airframes or powerplants, appropriate to the rating sought".

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.77, Experience requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: An applicant relies on documentary evidence of practical experience under 65.77(b). Who must find that evidence satisfactory?

options.A: The applicant's employer
options.B: A certificated repair station
options.C: The holder of an inspection authorization
options.D: The Administrator

questions.explanation: 65.77(b) calls for "Documentary evidence, satisfactory to the Administrator, of—" the listed experience.

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.77, Experience requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Which tests does 65.79 say an applicant for a mechanic certificate or rating must pass?

options.A: A practical test only
options.B: An oral test only
options.C: An oral test and a practical test, as appropriate to the rating sought
options.D: A second written test for each rating

questions.explanation: Each applicant "must pass an oral test and a practical test, as appropriate to the rating sought".

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.79, Skill requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: How does 65.79 say the applicant passes the oral and practical tests?

options.A: By presenting maintenance records of work the applicant has signed off
options.B: By demonstrating satisfactory understanding of the knowledge, risk management, and skill elements for each subject contained in the Aviation Mechanic General, Airframe, and Powerplant Airmen Certification Standards, as appropriate to the rating sought
options.C: By demonstrating the skill elements only, for subjects the applicant selects
options.D: By repeating the written test in front of an examiner

questions.explanation: The applicant passes "by demonstrating satisfactory understanding of the knowledge, risk management, and skill elements for each subject contained in the Aviation Mechanic General, Airframe, and Powerplant Airmen Certification Standards".

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.79, Skill requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Dana is not a student at an aviation maintenance technician school. Under 65.75(b), what must Dana do before applying for the oral and practical tests prescribed by 65.79?

options.A: Pass each section of the written test
options.B: Pass at least one section of the written test
options.C: Obtain an inspection authorization
options.D: Hold the mechanic certificate for 90 days

questions.explanation: "The applicant must pass each section of the test before applying for the oral and practical tests prescribed by § 65.79."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.75, Knowledge requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: An applicant has not yet met the experience requirements of 65.77. Under 65.75(c), which written test may the applicant take, and on what condition?

options.A: The airframe and powerplant written tests, if a certificated mechanic vouches for the applicant
options.B: Any written test, if the applicant is at least 18 years of age
options.C: The mechanic general written test, if the applicant presents a letter from an employer
options.D: The mechanic general written test, if the applicant presents an authenticated document from a certificated aviation maintenance technician school showing satisfactory completion of the general portion of the school's curriculum and specifying the completion date

questions.explanation: The applicant "may take the mechanic general written test prior to meeting the applicable experience requirements of § 65.77, provided the applicant presents an authenticated document from a certificated aviation maintenance technician school that demonstrates satisfactory completion of the general portion of the school's curriculum and specifies the completion date."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.75, Knowledge requirements (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 65.80, when may a qualifying student take the oral and practical tests prescribed by 65.79?

options.A: Only after graduating from the school
options.B: Only after passing each section of the written test
options.C: During the final subjects of the student's training in the curriculum required under part 147
options.D: At any time after enrolling in the school

questions.explanation: The "student may take those tests during the final subjects of the student's training in the curriculum required under part 147, before the student meets the applicable experience requirements of § 65.77 and before the student passes each section of the written test prescribed by § 65.75."

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.80, Certificated aviation maintenance technician school students (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 65.80, who must show the Administrator that a student has made satisfactory progress and is prepared to take the oral and practical tests?

options.A: The student
options.B: An aviation maintenance technician school certificated under part 147
options.C: A certificated mechanic who supervised the student's work
options.D: The holder of an inspection authorization

questions.explanation: 65.80 applies "Whenever an aviation maintenance technician school certificated under part 147 of this chapter shows to the Administrator that any of its students has made satisfactory progress at the school and is prepared to take the oral and practical tests".

source.title: eCFR: 14 CFR 65.80, Certificated aviation maintenance technician school students (as of Nov 4, 2026)
